title: GoldCast Phase 5 — Session Edge Test (pooled OOS, real costs)

knockout_fact.interpretation: Removing just 3 of 79 trades turns S1's mean from +13.68 to -0.69 pips/trade — the entire edge is carried by three outliers.

verdicts.S1: Looks good (PF 1.42) but p=0.2414, n=79, top-3 trades carry everything — noise, not edge
verdicts.S2: PF 1.01, p=0.911, max DD 3,930 pips — indistinguishable from zero; no edge
verdicts.S3-ALL: Generic 3-bar momentum entries: PF 1.05, +3.72 pips/trade over n=2,855 — thin and not independently bootstrapped; no demonstrated edge
verdicts.S3-VOL: High-vol-timed entries avg +0.15 pips/trade vs +5.83 OFF; VOL−OFF = -5.677, p=0.467 — timing does NOT improve the same entry
verdicts.S3-OFF: Off-hours entries avg +5.83 pips/trade (n=2,363), better than VOL — the vol engine's timing does not monetize this entry
verdicts.overall: NO session edge detected on XAUUSD H1 pooled OOS with real spread costs; positive totals without bootstrap significance are noise, not edge

protocol.evaluation: Same Phase-1 walk-forward folds (train40/test10/step10, 6 folds); trades on test slices only, pooled out-of-sample
protocol.costs: Real CSV SPREAD charged per entry; point=0.01, pip=0.10
protocol.S1: Asian range = 01:00-06:00 UTC; entry on first H1 close at 07:00-10:00 beyond the range; skip if range > 1.5xATR14 or < 0.3xATR14; flatten 16:00
protocol.S2: London move = close[11:00] - open[07:00]; if |move| > 0.5xATR14 enter at the 12:00 open same direction; flatten 16:00
protocol.S3: 3-bar momentum entries; ALL = every signal, VOL = p_high_vol > 0.5, OFF = p_high_vol <= 0.5; engine (HistGradientBoosting, Phase-2 gbm_price features) retrained per fold on TRAIN slice only
protocol.exits: SL = 1.0xATR14[signal bar], TP = 2.0xSL, time-stop = min(24 bars, session-end rule); intrabar SL/TP collision resolved SL-first (conservative); one position at a time per strategy/variant
protocol.determinism: sklearn seed 42; bootstrap 10,000 resamples with np.random.default_rng(42)
protocol.tuning: Parameters exactly as SPEC_PHASE5.md — a hypothesis test; no sweeps, no tuning
